findings.title: Cache fill is not rechecked under the write lock
findings.body: GetWebAssets snapshots entryPointAssetsCache under a read lock, drops that lock, and only then takes the write lock and always reloads and assigns entryPointAssetsCache. Two callers that both observe a nil cache can both enter the write section. If the first finishes and publishes a good manifest, the second still overwrites it—including with nil when its read fails—so a successful fill is discarded and later non-dev callers miss the cache or all redo the load. After Lock, re-read the cache and return it when non-nil and not in dev, and do not assign a failed result over an existing entry.
